The exact Finn–Hana gap is three slots between them, and Finn is before Hana, so Hana is four positions after Finn. Ivo is immediately after Hana, and Ben–Cara–Dev must occupy the three slots immediately after that. The only placement that leaves those five seats is Finn in 1, Hana–Ivo in 5–6, and Ben–Cara–Dev in 7–9.

Slots 2–4 are Ann, Elif, and Gus. Elif before Ivo, exactly one slot between Elif and Gus, Ann before Gus, and Ann three slots from Ivo force Elif, Ann, Gus.

Every other block placement contradicts at least one constraint.
